items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1969-12-30
items.q: I think you wrote to Ropeman you went to Mandeville

ctx.x: Yes, it was. When I was courting my wife, I was ready to get engaged to my wife and at nine o'clock, if I wasn't home, my daddy was on the corner blowing that whistle for me to get home.

So you had a fairly good age even then. That's right. When you went over across the lake into Susquehanna, I think you wrote to Ropeman you went to Mandeville, and then Buddy had a place. In Covington.

To Covington. Right. In Covington. Buddy had an old shack way back in the woods. What would you all talk about? Well, just everything in general. We'd be cooking on his stove and I would share some of his vittles with him, talk about music and at regular procedure, how I'm doing and how you're doing and so forth and so on.
